text:
samir_ml: Heads up, bring-up for model-x-1.0 hitting a weird HF->Redwood chat_template conversion bug. Jinja sentinels are getting escaped and the system role is ending up after the first user message in the rendered prompt. Causes downstream eval regressions in quantized builds. Anyone seen this?

jemma_research: Oof, can you paste a minimal repro template + config.json mapping?

samir_ml: Sure — short one below. Note the special token set and role_map in config.json. Repro is deterministic on our infra.

samir_ml: ```jinja
{% raw %}{% set system %}You are a helpful assistant.{% endset %}
- role: system
  content: "{{ system }}"
- role: user
  content: "{{ user_prompt }}"
{% endraw %}
```

samir_ml: config snippet: `\{"role_map\": {\"system\": \"system\", \"assistant\": \"assistant\", \"user\": \"user\"}, \"special_tokens\": {\"bos_token\": \"<s>\", \"eos_token\": \"</s>\", \"additional_special_tokens\": [\"<|assistant|>\"]}}`

igor_infra: Two things I suspect: 1) the conversion pipeline pre-renders Jinja then escapes placeholders when a token pattern conflicts with the tokenizer (we added safe-escape for `{{` -> `\{\{`), 2) our role stitching step relies on naive position-based joins and assumes system always first. If pre-render changes lengths it can shuffle boundaries.

nora_eval: We measured a 1.4% drop in exact-match on the sanity eval when this conversion ran +8bit quant. Metrics jump correlated with templates that had system blocks as variables (not fixed literal).

samir_ml: Repro steps I used: `python tools/convert_hf_chat.py --template repro.j2 --config demo_config.json --out prompt.txt` then load prompt.txt into the runner. The prompt shows an escaped brace sequence like `\\{\\{ system \\}\\}` instead of `You are a helpful assistant.` or the system block is rendered but appended after user content.

jemma_research: Can you dump tokenizer.encode of the before/after strings? That usually exposes invisible special tokens or byte-split issues.

samir_ml: Pasted encode diffs in gist: https://example.gist/repro-encodes (internal). Short read: BPE split puts `<|assistant|>` adjacent to BOS and our joiner removed whitespace leading to role glue.

igor_infra: Quick fix idea: 1) in convert_hf_chat.py, skip the safe-escape path when the Jinja node is a top-level block named `system` or `assistant` 2) add role-aware join that inserts explicit sentinel separators instead of relying on whitespace.

nora_eval: Also add a regression test: the test should run on quantized model (int8) because quantization amplifies tiny formatting changes. Compare perplexity + 5-shot instruction outputs.

samir_ml: I'll open a draft PR with the two changes + tests. Tagging ops-bot to run the quantized nightly runner once the PR lands.

ops-bot: CI job queued: `nightly/quantized-regressions` — will run after PR target branch updates. :gear:

jemma_research: Nice. Also note we should log original Jinja AST node types in conversion logs so future weird templates are diagnosable. Small change but huge for debugging.

samir_ml: Agreed. Action items: (1) samir -> PR with skip-escape + sentinel inserts, (2) jemma -> add AST-level debug flag, (3) nora -> add int8 regression case. Back here when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
